Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: Introduced a misleading search snippet stating “Keith Urban returned as the host” for American Idol Season 12 without verifying the source content. This reflects over-reliance on search result excerpts rather than opening and confirming authoritative pages, risking misattribution of the host role (the correct host was Ryan Seacrest).
